criterion: Vitest (real database): an incoming transaction with the invoice's OCR and amount produces a suggested match, and nothing is booked until a user confirms it. Confirming posts the settlement under the invoice method, and revenue and VAT under the cash method.
Vitest: the matching passes give their confidence values. Below 0.70 there's no suggestion, only "needs a person".
Vitest: a partial payment leaves the remaining amount open; an overpayment is flagged; a credit note reduces the open amount.
Vitest: the paid, partly paid, overpaid, due tomorrow and overdue (first day, then weekly) events each create one IRM-156 event for members with invoices.manage only.
Playwright (WebKit, iPhone profiles): a suggested payment shows on the invoice and is confirmed with one tap.
